summary: The root نكل (nkl) refers to a punishment that serves as a deterrent. It warns others not to commit similar offenses and restrains the offender from repeating the crime.
lane: نَكَالٌ ذ Any punishment serving to give warning to others than the sufferer: (M, K, TA:) or that restrains the offender from repeating the offence. (Bd, ii. 6.)
